name: Liru
source:
Liru is the werewolf who lives with the protagonist.

Pretty, cool, and energetic, she looks forward to the protagonist returning from work to be able to welcome him warmly. Apart from being with him, nothing will please her more than eating [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Matsusaka_beef]Matsusaka beef[/url].

She may seem simple and not very smart, but she is a thoughtful girl who knows what she wants and is capable of making an immense effort to please those she loves.

[spoiler]The game allows us to see the escalation of their relationship via 3 "levels" of affection.[/spoiler]
